We've got the draft plan for the video recording of the September 18 show at the Orpheum — four stagehands on a four-hour crew call, intended for internal archive. Before I can approve this, I need to hear from the artist liaison and the labor coordinator to confirm their respective areas. Are there any restrictions or concerns I need to be aware of?
